title: Ms Elizabeth Morris — General Osteopathic Council decision (2023-01-20)
text:
GENERAL OSTEOPATHIC COUNCIL
PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT COMMITTEE

Case No: 856/5268

Professional Conduct Committee ISO Hearing

DECISION

Case of:
ELIZABETH MORRIS

Committee:
Andrew Harvey (Chair)

Morag MacKellar (Lay)

Kenneth McLean (Osteopath)

Legal Assessor: `
Peter Steel

Representation for Council:
David Collins

Representation for Osteopath: The Registrant did not appear and was not represented

Clerk to the Committee:
Sajinee Padhiar

Date of Hearing:
20 January 2023

Summary of Decision:

The Committee determined that it was necessary to impose an order of
suspension in order to protect the public.

This order will take effect immediately. It will have effect until the Professional Conduct Committee
decides on the allegations against the Registrant, subject to her right to appeal this decision in
accordance with section 24 of the Act or to apply to revoke the order under section 25 of the Act.
